title: Minecraft block model definition
description: Defines 3D models for blocks and items.

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: Inherit from another model file, specified as a namespace ID. When both parent and elements are set, this model's elements will override the parent model's elements.

ambientocclusion.title: Ambient occlusion
ambientocclusion.description: Whether to use ambient occlusion. Defaults to true. If a parent is set, the parent model's ambientocclusion overrides this model's ambientocclusion.

display.title: Display
display.description: Lists the display settings for the item model in different contexts.

textures.title: Textures
textures.description: Defines the block particle texture and texture variables used by the model. Values can be a texture file path (namespace ID) or another texture variable.

particle.description: The particle texture for the block. Also used when the player is inside a nether portal. Note: block breaking particles for non-model-rendered blocks may be hardcoded.

elements.title: Elements
elements.description: Lists all elements of the model. These elements can only be cuboids. When both parent and elements are set, this model's elements will override the parent model's elements.

positionProps.description: Lists the display settings for the item model in different contexts.

thirdperson_righthand.description: When held in the third-person right hand.

thirdperson_lefthand.description: When held in the third-person left hand.

firstperson_righthand.description: When held in the first-person right hand.

firstperson_lefthand.description: When held in the first-person left hand.

gui.description: When displayed in a GUI container.

fixed.description: When placed in an item frame. Note that translation takes priority over rotation.

textureReference.description: Texture variable value. Can be a texture resource path, another texture variable starting with #, or an object containing sprite and force_translucent.

sprite.description: Texture resource path. # texture variables cannot be used in object form.

force_translucent.description: Forces the texture to be treated as translucent even if it has no transparent pixels.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotates the model around the corresponding axes using [x, y, z] format.

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: Translates the model along the corresponding axes using [x, y, z] format. Values greater than 80 are treated as 80, and less than -80 as -80.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Scales the model along the corresponding axes using [x, y, z] format. Values greater than 4 are treated as 4.

angle.description: The angle for rotating an element around a single axis. Modern versions no longer restrict to multiples of 22.5 degrees or a -45 to 45 range.

faceType.description: Specifies whether the parent-defined face should not render when the block's specified face is covered by an opaque block. The specified face can be: down, up, north, south, west, or east. The face's brightness calculation is equivalent to the block's specified face.

vector22.description: Specifies the texture region using [x1, y1, x2, y2] format. If not set, defaults to the element's xyz position. Values below 0 or above 16 will cause abnormal texture display. Swapping x1 and x2 will flip the texture.

texture.description: Specifies the texture variable to use, prefixed with #. Texture variables are defined above in the textures section.
texture.title: Texture

cullface.title: Cullface
cullface.description: Specifies whether the parent-defined face should not render when the block's specified face is covered by an opaque block.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotates the texture by a specific angle. Can be 0, 90, 180, or 270. Defaults to 0. Rotation does not affect the uv region, but rotates that region.

tintindex.description: Tint index. -1 means no tinting. Item models can also specify the tint source index from the item model definition.

from.title: From
from.description: Specifies the starting point of a cuboid using [x, y, z] format. Values must be between -16 and 32.

to.title: To
to.description: Specifies the ending point of a cuboid using [x, y, z] format. Values must be between -16 and 32.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Sets the rotation of the element.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Sets the center of rotation using [x, y, z] coordinates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The rotation axis for the legacy single-axis rotation format. Can be x, y, or z.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: The angle for the legacy single-axis rotation format. Modern versions no longer restrict to multiples of 22.5 degrees or a -45 to 45 range.

x.title: X angle
x.description: The rotation angle around the X axis in the modern multi-axis rotation format.

y.title: Y angle
y.description: The rotation angle around the Y axis in the modern multi-axis rotation format.

z.title: Z angle
z.description: The rotation angle around the Z axis in the modern multi-axis rotation format.

rescale.title: Rescale
rescale.description: Whether to rescale to the full cuboid size. Defaults to false.

shade.title: Shade
shade.description: Whether to render shadows. Defaults to true.

light_emission.title: Light emission
light_emission.description: The minimum light level received by the element, from 0 to 15. Defaults to 0.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Contains all faces of a single element. If a face is not defined, it will not be rendered.

down.title: Down face
down.description: The face facing downward, negative Y direction.

up.title: Up face
up.description: The face facing upward, positive Y direction.

north.title: North face
north.description: The face facing north, negative Z direction.

south.title: South face
south.description: The face facing south, positive Z direction.

west.title: West face
west.description: The face facing west, negative X direction.

east.title: East face
east.description: The face facing east, positive X direction.
